query:
INSERT INTO song_playlists (song_id, playlist_id, position)
           SELECT $1, p.id,
                  (SELECT COALESCE(max(position), -1) + 1 FROM song_playlists sp WHERE sp.playlist_id = p.id)
           FROM playlists p
           WHERE p.id = ANY($2)
           ON CONFLICT (song_id, playlist_id) DO NOTHING
